customer: Honestly this is getting old. We're cutting down to one car and I sold you my hybrid sedan, but nobody told me how or when I actually get my money, and there's still a loan on it. Do I just keep paying the lender forever or what?
agent: Sorry for the confusion. Per our article "When and how you get paid," once the paperwork is signed you can be paid by bank draft at the store, by direct deposit (1 to 3 business days), or by check mailed to your address (5 to 7 business days). Since there's a loan on the sedan, we send the payoff to your lender within 2 business days and you receive the amount left over. Please keep making your loan payments until your lender confirms the payoff.
